{{Top|leg}}
'''Recon Mission D812''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] scouting team active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was led by [[Mils Gessak]]; their main goal was searching for [[Planet/Legends|planetoids]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that could serve as a forward outpost for assaults against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
